# Club Copy

> Club Copy is an independent Pacific Northwest record label based in British Columbia, Canada. House, jungle, instrumental hip-hop, and adjacent forms — digital and cassette. Small library. Long shelf life. It also runs a digital and physical record club for collecting those releases.

Club Copy is a record label imprint under Copy House Publishing that operates a record club (Free alerts, Club $5/yr for 30% off all music, Premium from $10/yr for 50% off all music plus Club Credit). Founded by Charlie Archer (CJ Archer). Nothing ships unless you choose it.
